title: Finite intrinsic open functor and pullback square
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. In the intrinsic constant-ring presentation [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback], transport extension by zero for an open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero] through the canonical module realization equivalences, and descend it termwise to the unbounded derived categories. For a commuting square $g_Uj=j^{\prime}g$, define the derived pullback-square comparison $j^*g_U^*\cong g^*(j^{\prime})^*$ by the inverse pullback compositor, the equality of the composite scheme maps, and the forward pullback compositor. It is the exact termwise descent of that square through the fixed realization comparisons. This defines the existing sfIntrinsicDerivedOpen and sfIntrinsicDerivedSquarePullback, with their specified derived composition and identity comparisons.
